What to tap during a challenge - my taps never seemed to change the outcome
Which floating tag is which guest - they stack on top of each other
Gold vs cash vs recipes - too many numbers with hover-only explanations

A warning/countdown before raids and a fair chance to defend
Banner that does not cover the guests
